verdicts.explanation: The paper states that the extrapolated room-temperature (300 K) ion conductivity of the surface region after CO2 reaction is 1.27 × 10−3 S/m, obtained from MLFF-MD Li+ diffusion extrapolated from high temperatures. The computational origin, the temperature, and the null secondary fields are all consistent with the paper.

The paper states that the extrapolated room-temperature (300 K) ion conductivity of the bulk region (seven central layers) is 2.15 × 10−4 S/m, from the same MLFF-MD analysis. The material, value, unit, computational origin, and temperature all match, and the secondary fields are null as the paper does not give them.
